notlar: WEAPON STATS: change a weapon's damage, draw speed, shot distance and max chain takedown (Weapons tab, WEAPON STATS). Every value shows how many other weapons share it, nothing is written until you confirm the summary, and Revert stats puts the original numbers back. SWAP PARTS: move a part of an item onto another of its own slots - one click puts the same sword model in both hands. IMPORT 3D now warns you when a part comes back with faces deleted, and a refused part tells you which patch to revert instead of blaming a game update.
